guardrails: Do not add unsupported skills, seniority, salary, hiring-outcome, or protected-class claims.
Do not alter model scores, candidate IDs, evidence keys, or score bands.
Use only sanitized backend context and model-core evidence.

jobFitAlignment.id: Bukti yang cocok: rest api, postgresql, typescript. Bukti yang masih kurang: deployment evidence, automated testing evidence.

overallImpression.id: CV memiliki bukti backend yang cukup jelas; bukti deployment dan dampak terukur masih perlu diperkuat.

forbidden: raw full CV text unless retention policy allows it

handoff_contract.purpose: Define GenAI as a secondary API-wrapper feature fed by deterministic model-core outputs, never by training cells.
wrapper_guardrails: Validate wrapper output against cv-analysis-v2 before persistence or user response.
Do not invent skills, jobs, companies, seniority, salary, hiring outcomes, credentials, or protected-class claims.
Do not alter model-core scores, model version, candidate membership, or evidence keys.
Keep output language in AnalyzeCvMultipartRequest enum: id/en.
Return safe fallback prose when GenAI is unavailable; never fail the trained model artifact because GenAI is unavailable.

wrapper_outputs.atsFriendliness.summary: Wrapper may summarize detectedIssues/evidence without changing score.
wrapper_outputs.generatedCv: Separate feature; training sets no generated CV content.
wrapper_outputs.jobFitAlignment.summary: Wrapper may turn summarySignals/missingSkills into product-safe prose without changing score.
wrapper_outputs.jobRecommendations[].nextStep: Wrapper-owned next step based on missingSkills/rankingSignals.
wrapper_outputs.jobRecommendations[].reason: Wrapper-owned prose based on candidate score/signals and backend-hydrated job metadata.
wrapper_outputs.overallImpression: Wrapper may rephrase deterministic placeholder summary into public cv-analysis-v2 string.
wrapper_outputs.sectionReviews: Wrapper-owned dynamic section reviews for detected sections only.
wrapper_outputs.topActionables: Wrapper-owned 1-3 actionables grounded only in model-core evidence and sanitized backend context.

training_owned_outputs: candidate reranking score/signals for supplied job IDs
